_comment: Source and dependency currency registry. Web-content sources are checked via source_currency.py (report/check[/--detect-changes] -> web-intel -> mark-checked). P33 added two dependency categories: software-dependency (pip packages, system binaries) and mcp-server (third-party MCP servers), checked token-free by tools/dependency_currency.py against PyPI/GitHub via the optional fields upstream_api (pypi|github_releases|binary|manual), check_url, package, pinned_constraint, validated_version, latest_seen, latest_seen_date. Written only through tools/registry_io.py (source_currency.py + traversal_engine.py accept). Do not hand-edit.

EUR-Lex primary (CELEX 32024R1689) is fetch-blocked from cloud egress; this url is the verbatim explorer fallback

sources.name: European Commission - Guidelines on transparency obligations for AI-generated content (AI Act Article 50)
sources.extraction_hint: Commission guidelines for Article 50 transparency obligations; states 'Article 50 of the AI Act applies from 2 August 2026'; watch for adoption-date and scope changes; reachable from cloud egress while EUR-Lex is not

sources.name: European Commission - Code of Practice on marking and labelling AI-generated content (published 2026-06-10)
sources.extraction_hint: voluntary Code of Practice giving practical steps for providers and deployers of generative AI to meet Article 50 marking and labelling duties; watch for a successor edition
